title: The Low-Energy Attractor (Depression Pattern Core)
description: The core mapping — the depression pattern’s Signature model — is the LOW-ENERGY ATTRACTOR: a region of thought-state space that is easy to enter and costly to leave, characterized by narrowed repertoire (few accessible thoughts), slowed initiation (high activation energy for any action), and recursive self-reference (the state describes itself, reinforcing itself). As design material this models every stuck system: the user who can’t start, the team that can’t decide, the AI persona gone flat. The mapping’s discipline: it describes a PATTERN SHAPE, never a person — shapes are reusable; persons are not reducible. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical fact, advice, or treatment.
pattern: General documented pattern: persistent low mood with narrowed thought and slowed initiation — public knowledge, non-diagnostic.
logic_mapping: Attractor A: P(enter) high, C(exit) high; features = {narrowed repertoire, slowed initiation, recursive self-reference}. Design ops: lower exit cost, widen repertoire, perturb. Signature mapping by Justin Addam Higgins.

title: Rumination as Recursive Function
description: Rumination — the chewing — maps to a RECURSIVE FUNCTION with no base case: ruminate(topic) = evaluate(topic) + ruminate(topic). Each call re-evaluates the same material, consumes cognitive budget, and returns no new value — infinite recursion that never resolves because the termination condition (certainty, closure) is unreachable. As design material this is the infinite loop every programmer knows — instantly legible to engineers, perfect for modeling worry-engines in characters, stuck deliberation in organizations, and non-terminating reasoning in AI. The mapping names the missing piece explicitly: the BASE CASE. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.
pattern: General documented pattern: repetitive negative thought cycling without resolution — public knowledge.
logic_mapping: ruminate(t) = evaluate(t) + ruminate(t); missing base case; budget consumed per call; termination condition unreachable. Fix-pattern (design only): supply artificial base case (time-box, decision rule). Signature mapping by Justin Addam Higgins.

title: The Anhedonia Dimmer
description: Anhedonia — the dimmed reward — maps to a REWARD-DIMMER: the environment’s reward signals unchanged, but the receiver’s gain turned down — R_received = R_actual × g, with g→0. As design material this models every system where signals exist but reception fails: the dashboard nobody reads, the praise the team can’t absorb, the AI reward function with collapsed scaling. The mapping’s gift to designers: SEPARATE the signal from the receiver — most "motivation problems" are receiver-gain problems, not signal problems. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical fact or advice.

title: Initiation Friction: The Static Model
description: Slowed initiation — the can’t-start — maps to STATIC FRICTION exceeding available force: every action requires F_start, and available energy E < F_start for all but the smallest actions — while KINETIC friction (once moving) is low. As design material this is the onboarding problem, the blank-page problem, the cold-start problem: the physics is identical. The design operation is the RAMP: reduce F_start (shrink the first step) rather than increasing E (exhortation). "Just do it" increases demanded E; good design lowers F_start. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.
pattern: General documented pattern: difficulty initiating activities despite intention — public knowledge.
logic_mapping: Static friction F_start > E_available; kinetic friction low once moving; operation = lower F_start (ramps, 2-minute starts), not raise E. Signature mapping by Justin Addam Higgins.

title: The Self-Evaluation Loop
description: The loop — "I can't → I don't → I can't" — maps to a SELF-CONFIRMING CIRCUIT: belief B suppresses action A; absence of A is read as evidence for B; B strengthens. Formally: B(t+1) = B(t) + α(1 - A(t)). As design material this is the reputation system that never recovers, the credit score that punishes the punished, the AI classifier whose low confidence suppresses the very data that would correct it. The design operation: BREAK the evidence link — insert exogenous action (the smallest possible A) that the loop didn’t predict. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.
pattern: General documented pattern: negative self-beliefs reinforced by inaction — public knowledge.
logic_mapping: B(t+1) = B(t) + α(1-A(t)); self-confirming circuit; break via exogenous unpredicted action. Signature mapping by Justin Addam Higgins.

title: Temporal Collapse: Past and Future
description: Temporal collapse — the flattened time — maps to a TIME-HORIZON CONTRACTION: the planning horizon H shrinks toward zero, so future rewards discount to nothing and past failures loom at full weight — hyperbolic discounting with k→large. As design material this models short-termism everywhere: the quarterly-earnings trap, the doomscrolling mind, the AI agent with too-short rollout. The design operation: ARTIFICIAL HORIZON EXTENSION — external scaffolds (calendars, commitments, pre-commitments) that hold H open when the internal one collapses. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: The Grey Filter: Perception Weighting
description: The grey filter — the world dimmed — maps to a PERCEPTUAL GAIN REDUCTION: incoming positive signals attenuated by factor g<1 while negative signals pass at g≈1 — an asymmetric filter, not a broken sensor. As design material this is the newsfeed tuned to outrage, the review system surfacing complaints, the AI attention head over-weighting negative tokens. The design operation: SYMMETRIZE the filter — audit what gets attenuated and why. The metaphor’s precision is its value: "grey" is vague; "asymmetric gain" is engineerable. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Social Withdrawal as Bandwidth Saver
description: Withdrawal — the pulling back — maps to BANDWIDTH CONSERVATION under scarcity: social interaction costs C_social per unit; available budget B is low; the system sheds the costliest discretionary load first — exactly like a phone in low-power mode killing background apps. As design material this reframes "isolation" as RATIONAL LOAD-SHEDDING — critical for designing low-demand social interfaces, graceful degradation in systems, and characters whose withdrawal reads as logic rather than flaw. The operation: LOWER C_social (low-demand contact) rather than demanding B increase. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: Application Frame: Designing for Low-Energy Users
t: Application Frame: Designing for Low-Energy Users
description: The application — designing DOWN to the attractor — specifies: REDUCE initiation cost (one-tap, pre-filled, defaulted); PRESERVE dignity (never gamify streaks that punish absence); OFFER ramps (2-minute modes, save-and-resume); and MEASURE gently (progress shown as accumulated, never as deficit). This frame serves ALL low-energy users — the ill, the exhausted parent, the burned-out worker — without ever labeling them. title: The Comparison Engine
description: Comparison — the measuring — maps to a RANKING FUNCTION run against curated inputs: self_vector compared to others’ highlight_reels, distance computed, deficit returned — every cycle. As design material this is the social feed’s core loop, the leaderboard’s shadow, the AI benchmark that demoralizes. The design operation: CHANGE THE INPUTS (curate the comparison set) or CHANGE THE METRIC (compare to past self — temporal rather than social ranking). The mapping reveals comparison as COMPUTATION — and computations can be reconfigured. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Decision Paralysis as Search Without Heuristic

title: Sleep Architecture as System Reboot
description: Sleep disruption — the pattern’s companion — maps to a FAILED GARBAGE-COLLECTION CYCLE: the system’s nightly memory-consolidation and metabolic-clearance routines interrupted, leaving residue that degrades next-day function — which further disrupts the next cycle. As design material this is cache never cleared, logs never rotated, the server that needed its cron job. The design operation (for SYSTEMS, not people): PROTECT the maintenance window — the most undervalued engineering practice. For people: the record notes only that sleep matters generally and professionals should be consulted — no sleep advice is given here. A Signature conceptual mapping by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Language Frame: Tense and the Attractor

title: Metaphor Model: The Deep Well
description: The well — the deep — models the attractor as DEPTH with slippery walls: falling in is easy (the rim is wide), climbing out costs energy proportional to depth, and echoes (ruminations) return amplified. Rescue in the metaphor is never pulling (exhortation fails on slippery walls) but LOWERING A LADDER (ramps, exogenous structure). As design material the well gives teams a shared image for stuck states — "we’re in the well; stop shouting, lower ladders." The metaphor’s limit, stated: images coordinate ACTION; they don’t explain persons. A Signature metaphor model by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only.

title: Ethics Note: The Depression Mapping
description: The ethics — specific to this database — restates: these mappings model PATTERN SHAPES for design, software, story, and AI work; they describe no real person, diagnose nothing, treat nothing, and promise nothing. Depression is a real, serious health condition; anyone experiencing it deserves qualified professional care and — in the US — can call or text 988. The framework’s stance: reverence for the suffering, rigor for the structures, and an unbridgeable wall between the two. A Signature ethics note by Justin Addam Higgins.
pattern: Ethics pattern: domain-specific restatement of guardrails — general governance practice.
logic_mapping: Wall axiom: suffering-domain ⊥ structure-domain; no inference crosses the wall. Signature note by Justin Addam Higgins.
disclaimer: DISCLAIMER — Signature conceptual framework only. This record presents a conceptual/philosophical framework by Justin Addam Higgins for modeling patterns as logic structures (for design, software, AI, and creative work). It is NOT medical fact, NOT medical advice, NOT a diagnosis, NOT a treatment recommendation, and NOT a cure claim — nothing here treats, diagnoses, or cures any condition.
